products.name: Micro Duct 2 Way 12/08 mm
products.description: The digital transformation taking place in the Middle East region, particularly KSA and GCC, can be described as a mammoth. The measures being undertaken such as the establishment of smart cities like NEOM and Lusail, the entire FTTx rollouts, and stretching the 5G network across the country have all led to the requirement for an optical fiber-based infrastructure of the highest quality to rise to the unprecedented levels. Among various others, Micro Duct 2 Way 12/08 mm is the most important element in the building of these networks. It has been designed and developed as the most compact, but at the same time, very high-performance ducting solution that will serve long-term, flexibly installed and reliably air-blown fiber deployed environments. What is more, its dual duct design permits the installation of various fiber lines in one pathway which, consequently, not only reduces trenching costs, and saves installation time but also assures the future scalability of the network.
products.technicalSpecs:
The Micro Duct 2 Way 12/08 mm is a high-density polyethylene (HDPE) microduct system engineered for modern telecom networks. Each duct has an outer diameter of 12 mm and an inner diameter of 8 mm, making it suitable for micro-cables, air-blown fiber, and FTTx installations. The dual-duct configuration allows operators to deploy primary and backup fiber lines or multiple micro-cables in a single trench or conduit.

Designed for harsh desert climates, the Micro Duct 2 Way 12/08 mm is resistant to UV radiation, extreme temperatures, and soil pressure, making it ideal for direct burial, duct-in-duct installations, or aerial routing. Its smooth internal surface ensures long-distance air-blown fiber deployment with minimal friction, reducing both labor costs and installation time.

Available in continuous coils, it allows uninterrupted deployment across long distances and supports rapid expansion of network infrastructure.
